comments.body:
If you're looking for cheap writing paper, **Aldi** and **Lidl** are definitely worth checking out! They often have good deals on stationery, including packs of writing paper, especially when they have their special offers. You can usually find quality paper at very affordable prices.

Migros is also a solid option, but if you're really looking to save, I'd suggest comparing prices at **Aldi** or **Lidl**. Another alternative might be online stores like **Amazon** or **eBay**, where you can sometimes score bulk paper at lower prices.

Also, if you're interested in saving time on other things like essay writing, check out this [post about the best assignment writing services in 2024](https://www.reddit.com/r/StudyMind/comments/1hhqk3l/best_assignment_writing_services_in_2024/). It’s a helpful resource if you need assistance with more than just paper!
